title: Special Needs Plans Service Areas, Approved Capacity, Star Ratings and Election Dating
content:
Each plan benefit package in the Special Needs Plans category is certified for a named set of counties and for a maximum membership, carries the most recent overall star rating published for it, and carries the rules that turn an accepted election and an accepted disenrollment into dates, together with the special election period a member of that package may ordinarily use.

## Service area, approved capacity and star rating

| Plan benefit package | Counties in which the package may be sold and held | Maximum membership approved | Most recent overall star rating |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | Ridgecrest; Alder; Marwick | 16000 | 4.0 |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | Ridgecrest; Alder; Marwick | 9400 | 4.5 |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | Ridgecrest; Alder; Marwick; Sable Hollow | 6800 | 3.5 |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | Ridgecrest; Alder; Marwick; Sable Hollow | 7900 | 4.0 |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | Ridgecrest; Alder; Marwick; Sable Hollow; Fenn | 4100 | 3.5 |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | Ridgecrest; Alder; Marwick | 2300 | 4.0 |

## Election dating and special election period

| Plan benefit package | An accepted election takes effect | An accepted disenrollment takes effect | Special election period ordinarily available |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | the dual eligible and low-income subsidy special election period |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | the dual eligible and low-income subsidy special election period |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | the chronic condition special election period |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | the chronic condition special election period |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | the chronic condition special election period |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | the first day of the month following receipt | the last day of the month of receipt | the institutional special election period |

## Basis of each column

The counties column is the counties in which the package may be sold and held. The membership column is the maximum number of members approved for that plan benefit package. The rating column is the most recent overall star rating published for the package, on a scale running from 1.0 to 5.0. The two dating columns are the rule that turns an accepted election into a coverage start date and the rule that turns an accepted disenrollment into a coverage end date. The last column is the special election period a member of that package may ordinarily use.

## Reading the schedule

The widest service area in the category is that of Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP), which covers Ridgecrest, Alder, Marwick, Sable Hollow and Fenn; that package also carries the smallest approved membership but one, at 4100. The largest approved membership is that of Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP), at 16000, and the smallest that of Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP), at 2300. Every package in the category dates an accepted election to the first day of the month following receipt and an accepted disenrollment to the last day of the month of receipt.
